# WORK PLAN — the sole agent's sequenced build (generated by `tools/generate_work_plan.py`)

Total work items: **266** across milestones M0–M6. Generated — do not hand-edit; change the generator and re-run. Status and evidence live in `TASKBOARD.md`; process in `AGENT_PROMPT.md`; gates in `docs/14` and `docs/86`.

## How to use this plan (the sole agent reads this once per session)
- Work items are listed in **build order**. Take the first item whose status in `TASKBOARD.md` is not DONE and whose dependencies are DONE. Do not skip ahead because an item looks more interesting.
- A work item = **one deliverable + its paired test**. Extra files are allowed only when the item's spec requires them (e.g. a fixture it names) — list every file touched in the handover.
- Before starting an item: read the cited spec sections in full, write the contract (inputs / outputs / errors / formulas / keys) into the TASKBOARD note, write the paired test from the spec's oracle FIRST, watch it fail for the right reason, then implement.
- After finishing: run the self-verification protocol (`AGENT_PROMPT.md` §6), paste evidence into TASKBOARD, commit as `WI-####: <path>`.
- If the spec is silent or contradictory: **fix the owning doc first** (`docs/00_INDEX.md` §5 decides who owns the fact), log it in `docs/CHANGELOG.md` (+ DEC in doc 17 §4 if contract-affecting), then build. Design decisions → decide them (the owner delegated decisions, DEC-010): record `DEC-nnn (auto)` in doc 17 §4 with alternatives and reversal cost, write the behaviour into the owning doc, proceed.

### Universal edge-case checklist (every item: handled + tested, or stated N/A with reason in the handover)
Zero amounts / zero denominators · negative amounts and credit-normal accounts · empty input · single row · duplicate input · 250k-row posture · missing optional data (rule → not_run, export → labelled, UI → empty state) · locked period / locked version · superseded batch · expired waiver · hostile text (quotes, `=formula`, `<script>`, unicode, 10k-char description) · ambiguous dates/amounts · currency minor-unit exponent 0/2/3 · month-2 reuse (no month-1 assumptions hard-coded) · deterministic repeat run.

### Forbidden in every item
Float on money · TODO/TBD/stub/mock-only paths · weakening a test, bar or threshold · inventing an API/field/key/threshold not in the docs · a second implementation of an owned concern (doc 04 §2) · user text with "error"/"fraud" for findings · telemetry or network outside `app/ai/client.py` · hand-editing generated files (regenerate them) · committing data with real financials.

### WI-0139 · `app/connectors/transport.py` · connectors
- **Mission:** The ONLY outbound HTTP path besides app/ai/client.py: httpx client with mandatory TLS verification, connect 10s / read connector.timeout_s, egress allow-list enforced per request incl. redirects (login.microsoftonline.com + configured host; 127.0.0.1 only when connector.allow_demo_host on the sample project), retry with Retry-After + exponential backoff (1-2-4-8-16s, max connector.retry_max_attempts) on 429/503/timeouts, request logging without query values/bodies, token-redacted exceptions.
- **Depends on (WI ids, must be DONE):** WI-0035, WI-0028, WI-0136  ·  **Read first:** core/logging, core/errors, connectors/models, docs/12 §1(d), docs/26 §8.2/8.4, docs/62
- **Inputs:** request spec + token provider  ·  **Provides:** parsed JSON/XML pages
- **Acceptance (evidence required):** Non-allow-listed host -> ERR-113 before any socket (asserted with a socket-block fixture); redirect to another host refused; http:// refused; 429 with Retry-After honoured then success; 5 failures -> ERR-115 with attempts=5 logged; a synthetic JWT in a failing request never appears in the exception text or logs; no code path performs POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE.
- **Paired test:** `tests/unit/test_connector_transport.py`
- **Notes:** Security envelope lives here; everything else trusts it.
